rules.law_name: Forbidding the Algorithmic Inflation of Rent (FAIR) Act
rules.effective_date_basis: This act shall take effect on the first day of the twelfth month next following the date of enactment.
rules.title: Ban on algorithmic rent coordination for residential rentals
rules.requirement: Rental property owners may not pay for or use a coordinator, and coordinators or other persons may not perform coordinating functions or facilitate parallel pricing coordination for residential dwelling units. The ban targets algorithmic or automated use of competitively sensitive rental information to set or recommend rents, material lease terms, or occupancy levels.

coverage.other_unresolvable: Applies to rental property owners and residential dwelling units intended to be used as a primary residence in New Jersey, with exclusions based on facility type.
coverage.summary: Covers New Jersey residential dwelling units used as a primary residence, including houses, apartments, and accessory units, and applies to owners of one or more such rental units.

rules.exemptions: “Algorithmic device” excludes certain non-AI spreadsheets requiring human analysis and databases that only query unprocessed data. “Coordinating function” excludes research, statistical analysis, or testing not used to set or recommend rental terms; public no-cost rent estimates; certain real estate brokerage databases; and government entities setting or limiting rents or sale prices through lawful affordability controls. “Residential dwelling unit” excludes inpatient medical care, licensed long-term care, and detention or correctional facilities.
rules.penalty: A violation is unlawful and is a violation of the New Jersey Antitrust Act; the act states it does not limit application of C.56:9-6 through 9-17 to a violation of section 4.
rules.interaction: The act is construed as in addition to the New Jersey Antitrust Act and prohibits municipalities from enacting conflicting ordinances, while preserving ordinances explicitly authorized or required by other law.
